comparison_with_original_local_proof.interpretation: The tiny differences are in independently computed dense-reference quantities and associated error summaries. This receipt comparison makes no cross-machine performance claim.

conclusion: The hosted run reproduces the declared finite-grid kernel acceptance and train-only paired preflight under unchanged scientific sources, thresholds and jobs. It is numerical implementation fidelity evidence, not Brownian spatial exactness, global optimization, neural mechanism superiority or large-model scaling evidence.

environment.observation_scope: Actual published prepare-time process/environment observations; preparation OOM=0 is not an independent audit of the entire later training lifetime.

limitations: The proof concerns the frozen finite-grid regenerative Markov operator and its accelerated polynomial evaluation, not an exact spatial discretization of continuous Brownian dynamics.
The earlier scalar free-boundary versus finite-grid policy-optimality gap is unchanged; no new Bellman/QVI optimality certificate is supplied here.

Gradients are checked at declared points away from switching surfaces. At the exact reset interpolation knot there is no unique ordinary derivative; the recorded 0.21516286534912255 autodiff convention is preserved, rather than promoted to a global differentiability claim.

The stable long-stream profile explicitly applies bounded regenerative unit-mass roundoff correction; the correction and its accumulated magnitude are reported. Event totals accumulate float32 per-step counts in Python binary64.
Positive physical-group gradients and parameter changes establish local trainability in these probes, not causal accuracy or efficiency contributions.
Preflight timings include correctness audit and are descriptive only. No speed claim is based on comparison with the earlier local machine.
Heldout exposure was repeated by the full hosted engineering replication; this is not fresh-test confirmation.
No GPU, energy, neuromorphic hardware, multimodal foundation-model or universal architecture advantage is established by this audit.

long_stream.count_accumulation: Python binary64 over float32 per-step expected counts

math_configuration.independent_reference: scalar physical jump assembly, SciPy augmented expm and dense value solve

measured_preparation_cost.scope: The kernel-body clock is contained in the kernel wait4 clock, which is contained in the preparation child total; these are not additive. Checkout, dependency installation, full training and this later audit are outside this subtotal.

preflight.performance_scope: Three small paired train-only steps per task; descriptive, includes correctness audit; not formal throughput evidence

registration_binding.full_cohort_quality_and_speed_review: Separate audit; not inferred from PREPARED or this proof.
